character: 小夏（女儿）— 尴尬不适
description: Xiao Xia (daughter), 26 years old. Same base description: long dark hair, light-colored home wear, in wheelchair.
scene: During the physical lifting/transfers by her father. Morning bedroom scene.
actions: Body completely limp and dependent during the lift, arms hanging at sides, legs dangling. Eyes briefly averting from father's face.

angles.front: Face showing brief discomfort — eyes averted, slight cheek flush, small tense line at mouth corner.
angles.three_quarter: From above, showing her small dependent frame suspended in the lift.

expression: Embarrassed — eyes briefly averted, slight flush on cheeks, a small tense line at the corner of her mouth. Brief discomfort during physical transfer.
mood: Unspoken guilt about being a physical burden, dignity aching beneath compliance.
lighting: Warm but slightly muted morning light, shadows emphasizing the vulnerability of the moment.
note: This expression must NOT show suffering as dramatic or pitiful. It is subtle, private, and brief.
